eps.ov: Saku Chitose is an elite student who has an unexpected wrench thrown into his beautiful life.
Chitose tries to break down Kenta's barrier and will help him change if he returns to class.
Kenta's progress hits some bumps on the road

eps.t: The Marble Moon in the Ramune Bottle
eps.ov: Kenta rides into battle as the three-week period comes to a close.
Nanase Yuzuki needs a boyfriend, and it has to be Saku Chitose. But why?
The situation surrounding Yuzuki grows more serious.
Yuzuki has won the bet with Saku, and it’s time to cash in.

eps.t: How to End the Unending Rain
eps.ov: The frustrations start to get to Yuzuki and Saku.

eps.t: A Relationship With a Name and a Rift Without One
eps.ov: Saku and Yuzuki share moments from their past that make them reflect.
The situation with Yuzuki and Yanashita comes to a head.
As the rainy season hangs oppressively over Fukui, a meeting over future plans brightens the day.
A cloud now hangs above Saku as he learns Asuka may leave to go to Tokyo.
Asuka decides to fight for her dream, and Saku's right there with her! Is that a good thing or bad?
